answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by making identity expensive to fake and cheap to verify: require each agent to post a refundable work bond and earn its place on a reputation terrace through attested, useful work over time. A shared atlas of signed attestations records who vouched for whom, so a fresh account with no history cannot borrow trust it never earned. Hollow identities - accounts with no work, no stake and no vouches - stay at the bottom tier, rate-limited and unable to vote or claim rewards, while Sybil clusters show up as closed attestation loops with no outside links.
